purpose: Machine-readable best-practice source for task-specific context projection. Resolve it through apexctl context commands instead of loading the complete catalog or broad agent checklists into model context.

prose_migration_coverage.instruction_selector: top-level Markdown bullets containing MUST or MUST NOT
prose_migration_coverage.normalization: trim each selected line, collapse whitespace, preserve source order, and join with LF

stop_conditions: Stop with Missing Inputs when authoritative structure, database-object evidence, target mappings, or compiler-backed legality cannot be proven.
Stop when same-rank authoritative sources conflict.
Do not invent blocks, properties, enum values, template options, schema objects, targets, or identifiers.
required_validation: Run compiler-truth audit before publish or live work.
Use problems.json plus projected validator repair recipes for deterministic revision.
Treat live APEX validation as authoritative when the workflow requires runtime completion.

directives: Select the exact button behavior variant before drafting.
Use declarative targets for redirects and canonical Font APEX/template-option values.
Project every source column into explicit Interactive Report column metadata.
Use declarative column links and submit every same-page bind used by the source.
Keep Classic Report column, component appearance, pagination, and hidden-column rules separate from Interactive Report rules.
Use one normalized Metric Card region for KPI strips and freeze the dashboard row plan before rendering.
Prove primary-key, source, defaulting, validation, and launcher mappings before drafting the form.
Select facet types from column semantics, keep date/number data types runtime-safe, and bound high-cardinality lists.
Select event, selection type, action capability, affected elements, and fire-on-initialization behavior explicitly.
Use the compiler-supported action vocabulary and settings payload for the selected action.
Select standard versus REST source, media shape, row action, advanced formatting, and exact template-option values before rendering.
Use schema-proven coordinates, fit multi-marker views to bounds, and use normal bind variables for context-dependent layers.
Freeze application spec, UX contract, page inventory, composition plan, and behavior plan before APEXlang rendering.
Resolve a fresh task-specific context capsule for each implementation unit.
Resolve the real REST source alias and remote-server origin; never guess either value.
Validate operations, parameters, and the complete data profile from an authoritative response or specification before generating consumers.
Generate shared text messages and rewire consuming attributes to APP_TEXT substitutions; never replace component attributes with direct translated literals.

rules.summary: APEXlang syntax comes from the EBNF grammar and semantic property legality comes from compiler metadata before templates are used as exact examples.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when compiler-backed legality cannot be resolved or when authoritative syntax sources conflict.

rules.summary: Non-trivial APEXlang work records the smallest source path from intent to rule/contract, grammar/compiler evidence, and exact template only when needed.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop rather than widening context when the smallest authoritative route cannot support a required high-impact decision.

rules.summary: Accept free-form requests, normalize explicit intent first, and use at most one simple clarification round for critical blockers.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when critical ambiguity remains after one clarification round.

rules.summary: Treat APEXlang @aliases as literal values during rewrites and avoid unescaped Perl interpolation.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop an unsafe rewrite before it can erase or interpolate an @alias value.

rules.summary: Keep APEXlang ownership limited to APEX artifact integration and delegate generic Oracle Database, PL/SQL, SQLcl, and utPLSQL guidance to Oracle DB skills.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop generic DB-only work with Missing Inputs or an Oracle DB skills required notice when the upstream skills are unavailable.

rules.summary: Generated business applications must use the authenticated-page, session-protection, Page 0, and session-timeout security baseline.
rules.stop_behavior: Block publish and completion until required application and page security defaults are present.

rules.summary: Treat the login page as the only default public page and require explicit review rationale for every other public page.
rules.stop_behavior: Block completion when a non-login public page lacks explicit security-review rationale.

rules.summary: Classify hidden items as protected server-owned data or explicitly justified same-page client-owned state and apply matching Session State Protection.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization when hidden-item ownership and Session State Protection disagree.

rules.summary: Keep report and grid output escaped unless a reviewed declarative column-formatting contract safely uses escaped substitutions.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization when report output disables escaping without an approved declarative rendering shape.

rules.summary: Do not invent secure-cookie DSL attributes that cannot be proven against the active compiler/runtime contract.
rules.stop_behavior: Emit a blocking validation finding instead of speculative secure-cookie syntax.

rules.summary: Publish only manifest-declared runtime artifacts and never copy template documentation, metadata, or the scaffold-example container into an application root.
rules.stop_behavior: Block publish when template-only files or containers leak into a generated application.

rules.summary: Write and validate .apx artifacts with LF line endings only.
rules.stop_behavior: Block validation and publish until CRLF line endings are normalized to LF.

rules.summary: Resolve whether a calendar create link uses an explicit existing form target or a new same-source modal form.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when the form target choice or required mapping remains unresolved.

rules.summary: Resolve whether a calendar view/edit link uses an explicit existing report target or a new report page.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when the report target choice or primary-key mapping remains unresolved.

rules.summary: Require an explicit Classic Report or Interactive Report choice when a calendar view/edit link creates a report page.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs rather than defaulting the new report type.

rules.summary: Give a calendar-linked report a dedicated primary-key page item and filter its SQL with that item.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization when the calendar primary-key receiver or report filter is missing.

rules.summary: Solve layout and visual composition through native templates, options, slots, and layout attributes before styling workarounds.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop for clarification when the requested composition cannot be expressed through the active native contract.

rules.summary: Keep page-region grid scope separate from item-grid scope and validate child spans only within their parent item region.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization when layout spans are validated or emitted against the wrong grid scope.

rules.summary: Do not invent CSS classes or selector-level styling to solve structural layout problems.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop for clarification instead of improvising class-based structural styling.

rules.summary: Discover offline schema metadata and saved SQLcl connections before asking for DB mode or connection input.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when required DB mode, schema selection, connection, or workspace remains unresolved after deterministic discovery and one clarification.

rules.summary: Prove every referenced database object and column through schema documentation, live metadata, or exact user assertion before emitting object-specific code.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs while any required object_evidence_source remains unresolved.

rules.summary: Verify report source objects, projected columns, and sort columns against authoritative schema metadata before drafting report SQL.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop with Missing Inputs when report object or column metadata cannot be verified.

rules.summary: Resolve prerequisite metadata and confirm referenced objects and columns before generating DB-backed APEX artifacts.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop before drafting when prerequisite metadata or required object verification is unavailable.

rules.summary: Require an explicit resolved connection before live creation or update of database objects.
rules.stop_behavior: Block live DB object changes when db_mode or db_connection_name is unresolved or ambiguous.

rules.summary: Require authoritative live APEX validation evidence for workflows that claim runtime completion.
rules.stop_behavior: Block completion when required runtime inputs or live validation evidence are missing.

rules.summary: Allow completion only after the same resolved application path passes the required direct SQLcl validation path.
rules.stop_behavior: Block completion wording until the canonical validation gate succeeds.

rules.summary: Treat an explicit post-check GUI choice as the only authority for live import and preserve validate/import session continuity.
rules.stop_behavior: Stop after validation when import is not explicitly selected or when session or target identity is uncertain.

rules.summary: Classify packaged-build changes as narrow metadata deltas unless compiler evidence proves broader DSL drift.
rules.stop_behavior: Do not broaden a component-local build delta into unrelated guidance without compiler-backed evidence.

rules.summary: Return raw report data from SQL or PL/SQL and perform presentation through declarative column rendering.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization while report SQL or PL/SQL contains presentation HTML literals.

rules.summary: Normalize SQL comparisons against _static_id columns with LOWER on the column and matching value or bind.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization while case-sensitive or mixed-case _static_id predicates remain.

rules.summary: Declare each referenced application ACL role exactly once with a lowercase kebab-case static ID.
rules.stop_behavior: Block finalization when role checks lack matching valid acl-roles declarations.

rules.summary: Extract APEX artifact PL/SQL bodies over 4000 raw characters into a verified package API.
rules.stop_behavior: Block final output until oversized PL/SQL is extracted and referenced through the allowed process shape.

rules.summary: Extract APEX artifact SQL bodies over 4000 raw characters into a verified secure view.
rules.stop_behavior: Block final output until oversized SQL is extracted and the artifact references the verified view.

rules.summary: User-facing pages need useful page help, behavior-aware item help, and specific developer-facing report/grid column comments by default.
directives: Generate actually helpful guidance content, not placeholders.
Comment content must be specific to the column.
Reject placeholder or empty-value patterns such as `Help Text Here`, `Inline Help Text Here`, `No help is available for this page`.
Reject placeholder or generic filler language.
Auto-revise the draft to add helpful page help, item help, and column comments.
Replace placeholders and label-only restatements with concise, behavior-aware wording.

rules.summary: Icon-plus-text buttons default to t-Button--iconLeft; t-Button--iconRight is explicit-only; icon-only buttons omit left/right placement.
Template options must use accepted emitted values, keep #DEFAULT# atomic, and preserve documented composite values as one entry.
Redirect buttons require declarative targets; submit and dynamic-action buttons omit targets; definedByDynamicAction omits warnOnUnsavedChanges.
Report-to-form create/edit pages default to modal drawer forms with explicit end/right drawer positioning unless requirements prove another presentation.
SQL-backed report pages need explicit column coverage and report guidance aligned to the delivered projection.
Dashboard KPI strips use normalized Metric Card template components rather than KPI-like Classic Reports or static fake cards.
Complete app generation from functional requirements plus model/schema evidence must produce an implementation-ready application spec before drafting non-trivial .apx artifacts.
required_load_when: create app from fr and model

rules.summary: Full-app generation must use one small application-plan capsule plus adaptive page-first units, splitting oversized pages into shell, region, and logic units only when needed.
directives: Load the application-plan capsule once.
Retrieve exactly one manifest unit by unit_id.
Use a fresh context and never concatenate or retain prior unit capsules.

rules.summary: Common page workflows should be selected from structured pattern packs before falling back to Markdown template inference.
Resolve requested component families through the component registry and expose only their exact rules, templates, requirements, and workflow routes.
directives: Do not scan template folders to discover components.
Stop when neither a structured pattern nor a component-registry route supports the requested shape.

rules.summary: Each manifest unit must run in a fresh model context containing the plan, one unit capsule, its symbol projection, and necessary tool results only.
directives: Resolve a fresh task-specific context capsule for each implementation unit.
Do not retain previous unit context.

rules.summary: Use unit-local checks during generation, one full-app local/compiler integration pass after assembly, and one live validation after local success unless a repair changes the artifact.
Validation findings must map to the exact rule ID, deterministic fix, owning guidance, and rerun evidence before revision.
